findings.current: And these days, Henan was boiling like a cauldron over a charcoal fire.
findings.defect: The established location term 하남성 is Henan Province, not merely Henan.
findings.rationale: The glossary explicitly maps 하남성 to Henan Province.
findings.replacement: And these days, Henan Province was boiling like a cauldron over a charcoal fire.
findings.source: 하물며 지금의 하남성은 숯불 위의 가마솥처럼 들끓고 있는 형국.

findings.current: Even that stray dog in the back alley probably knows.
findings.defect: The draft invents that the dog is a stray while omitting the source’s identifying yellow color.
findings.rationale: 황구 means a yellow dog; the source says nothing about it being a stray.
findings.replacement: Even that yellow dog in the back alley probably knows.

findings.current: But the madman who brought our Master over didn’t even give him a chance to stop him. He just said, ‘Their masters are the Fire King and the Sword Saint.’
findings.defect: The draft makes their Master the person denied a chance to intervene. The source instead says the madman blurted out the remark before the others could stop him.
findings.rationale: 말릴 틈도 없이 describes the speaker’s group having no time to restrain the madman, not the madman preventing their Master from acting.
findings.replacement: But before anyone could stop him, the madman who’d called our Master over blurted out, ‘Their masters are the Fire King and the Sword Saint.’
findings.source: 그런데 앞에 스승님을 불러온 그 미친놈이 말릴 틈도 없이 딱 그러더군. 걔들 스승님은 화왕에 검성이잖아요.

findings.current: I. Jin Taekyung, Pavilion Master of the Two Dragons Pavilion, took the side of one party despite a dispute taking place directly before him. He is therefore ordered to fast for a limited period.
findings.defect: The disciplinary wording omits that Taekyung improperly sided only with one party, weakening the stated basis for punishment.
findings.rationale: 사사로이 and 편만을 jointly characterize his intervention as improper partiality, not merely the neutral act of taking a side.
findings.replacement: I. Jin Taekyung, Pavilion Master of the Two Dragons Pavilion, improperly sided with only one party despite witnessing the dispute firsthand. He is therefore ordered to fast for a limited period.
findings.source: 一. 이룡각주 진태경은 눈앞에서 다툼이 벌어지고 있음에도 사사로이 한쪽의 편만을 들었으므로, 한정된 기간 금식(禁食)을 명한다.

findings.current: The rumor that Jin Taekyung had emptied ten bowls of gukbap[^1] and patted his stomach from the very seat where he had been disciplined the next day only made matters worse.
findings.defect: The draft invents a specific seat where Taekyung was disciplined. 앉은 자리에서 means he ate all ten bowls in one sitting.
findings.rationale: 앉은 자리에서 describes completing the feat without leaving his seat; it does not refer back to the location of the disciplinary decision.
findings.replacement: The next day, rumors spread that Jin Taekyung had polished off ten bowls of gukbap[^1] in one sitting and patted his stomach, which only made matters worse.
findings.source: 다음 날 진태경이 앉은 자리에서 국밥 열 그릇을 비우고 배를 두드렸다는 소문이 퍼지자 더욱 그럴 수밖에 없었다.

findings.current: There are other things written there too, but… Well, the whole thing is strange.
findings.defect: The draft changes nearby people into additional written content, erasing the speaker’s embarrassed reluctance to explain himself in front of others.
findings.rationale: 다른 사람도 있는데 refers to other people being present, not other material on the notice.
findings.replacement: Well, there are other people around, so… Ah, never mind. The whole thing is strange.
findings.source: 그게, 그러니까. 아, 아닐세. 차라리 직접 가서 보고 듣게.

findings.current: That was the exact moment the hundreds of people who had read the notice began shouting and cheering.
findings.defect: The draft turns the crowd’s mixed cheers and lamentations into uniformly positive cheering, losing the response of those disqualified by the Peak requirement.
findings.rationale: 환호와 탄식 explicitly pairs cheers with lamentations, matching the preceding triumphant and disappointed exclamations.
findings.replacement: At that exact moment, the hundreds of people who had read the notice let out their own cheers and groans.
findings.source: 방의 내용을 확인한 수백여 명의 좌중들이 저마다 환호와 탄식을 내뱉던 바로 그 순간이었다.

findings.defect: Honghakru is an unlisted romanized establishment name introduced without the required first-use explanation.
findings.rationale: The terminology rules require an established rendering or a concise first-use footnote for an unlisted romanized proper name.
findings.replacement:
“Isn’t that the band from Honghakru?[^2]”

[^2]: Honghakru, literally “Red Crane Pavilion,” is a renowned entertainment house in Henan.

findings.defect: Hongmae is an unlisted romanized name introduced without a first-use explanation.
findings.rationale: The terminology rules require an established rendering or a concise first-use footnote for an unlisted romanized name.
findings.replacement:
“Hongmae? It’s Hongmae![^3]”

[^3]: Hongmae literally means “Red Plum.”

findings.current: “More? They’re insane. Completely insane. There are so many that I’m starting to suspect Dark Heaven may have sent in applications too.”
findings.defect: The draft calls the applicants insane, while Hyuk Mujin is describing the overwhelming number of applications as crazy.
findings.rationale: 미쳤습니다 is an exclamation about the situation and scale established by the following sentence, not a judgment that the applicants themselves are insane.
findings.replacement: “More? It’s insane. Completely insane. There are so many that I’m starting to suspect Dark Heaven may have sent in applications too.”
findings.source: “미쳤습니다. 미쳤다고요. 암천 쪽에서도 지원서를 보낸 게 아닐까 의심이 될 정돕니다.”

findings.current: “Because of this fucking song, this old man almost suffered qi deviation.”
findings.defect: “Fucking” intensifies 빌어먹을 beyond its ordinary force in this complaint.
findings.rationale: 빌어먹을 is naturally “damn” or “damned” here; the stronger profanity adds aggression absent from the source.
findings.replacement: “Because of this damn song, this old man almost suffered qi deviation.”
findings.source: “이 빌어먹을 노래 때문에, 노부가 주화입마에 빠질 뻔했다.”

summary: Several fidelity defects alter physical details, official reasoning, speaker intent, crowd reactions, and the object of Hyuk Mujin’s criticism; two unlisted proper names also need first-use notes.
